ranking: Existing screening_shortlist: minimize the worst pool/composition mean difference, without averaging different scenario pools
performance_data_read: Only pre-existing engineering benchmark, not the running 1000-scene performance results
fallback: Keep L5 if no candidate satisfies the gates
review: Report retreat fraction, largest retreat and cost components; no claim that average improvement applies to every world
efficiency_gate: Require negative mean candidate-minus-baseline penalized cost in every pool/composition design group; inspect retained-mechanism effects separately
confirmation_rule: Freeze selected limits and development-results hash before reading confirmation performance; confirmation cannot be used to tune another limit
completion_gate: Reject any candidate with more failures than baseline in any pool/composition or mechanism stratum
